unresolved.question: What enables Ortho Patient / Ortho Primary / Ortho Secondary? "Enabled for Ortho" comes from our own capture; the meaning of the three checkboxes (patient-portion, primary-insurance, secondary-insurance periodic charges) and of Billing Date is inferred. No vendor source shows the PLAN TYPE = Ortho state of this report.

The effect of REPORT FORMAT Detail / Summary is inferred for Uncollected Copay. Vendor text says the report covers the patients on the schedule who have a patient balance due, which implies - but does not state - that Start Date / End Date select by appointment date; confirm on the live legacy screen.
Exact values of the Audit Type dropdown are unverified. Vendor text only lists the tracked actions: Edit, Delete, Close out, Reschedule Appointment, Cut/Copy - Paste Appointment.

Values of the Module Type dropdown other than ALL and Appointments are not documented, and the legacy order is unknown. Vendor text names the modules the Audit Trail tracks (Appointments, Patient, Setup, Transactions, Treatment Plan) and the sample output shows PATIENT / Patient, Transactions, Treatment Plan and Appointments in its Type column; that these are the dropdown values is presumed, not verified.
Contents of the User > SELECT dialog and of the Patient SEARCH dialog are not documented. That an empty Patient box means all patients comes from our own capture only.
Default of the Account / Patient radios in the patient-level `Audit Trail Report` dialog is not documented.

What enables `Group By Office` and what does it do? The document says disabled for a single office and infers grouping by office when several are selected; the vendor states that the office of a clock in / out is not tracked, yet the option exists.

Contents of the OFFICE/GROUP > SELECT dialog (and its Office Group variant) and of the User > SELECT dialog of Time Clock Report are not documented; the research document lists the contents of the SELECT / SEARCH dialogs as a gap.
